---
applyTo: "src/**/*.cs,src/**/*.cshtml,tests/**/*.cs"
---

# Modern .NET slice

- Target .NET 10 with nullable reference types and warnings as errors.
- Keep fixed-width parsing in the boundary layer and return safe domain views.
- Validate input explicitly and return clear 404/validation responses.
- Do not log source records or sensitive-shaped fields.
- Keep APIs read-only unless the task explicitly covers the complete write
  security and consistency model.
- Add tests for offsets, overpunch values, malformed records, linking, masking,
  route behavior, and any changed business summary.
- Preserve accessible HTML: semantic landmarks, labels, keyboard focus, reduced
  motion, sufficient contrast, and responsive tables.
